column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the transcriptstruct warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Records: One Tagged Record per Line, Attachments Decoded, Nothing Dropped
The Walk: Every String in a Record, at the Path That Reaches It
The Blocks: Content Decoded Whole, Attachments Included, the Unread Marked Unread
The Provenance: One Speaker Kind per Record, and the Operator Not Over-Counted
The Queries: Every Answer Carries Its Whole Denominator, and Nothing Is Snipped
The CLI: Unknown Flags Refused, the Cheap Read by Default, Every Answer's Denominator Printed
The Standing-Rule 8 Stop Check: A Human Hold Set This Turn Is Asked by Name This Turn
Search Rows: Each Row Carries the Record's Uuid and Timestamp So a Ruling Is Found and Warranted in One Call
A Memory File's Claimed Operator Quotes and Rulings Are Listed, and Nothing Else
Lines That Grant a Permission or Lift a Rule Are Flagged for Review First
A Claimed Quote Is Found in the Operator's Utterances or Reported Unwarranted
A Memory Directory Is Audited Against Its Project's Transcripts, Read-Only
The Cache Turns: One Row per API Call With Its Cache Read and Creation, the Gap Before It and What Woke It, a Cold Turn Flagged by a Stated Threshold
